questions.question: In your Student Data Assistant role, what databases, spreadsheets, or tracking mechanisms did you create or maintain, and how did you ensure the data remained accurate?
Describe a specific data-quality issue or discrepancy you identified in student records. How did you investigate it, correct it, and prevent it from recurring?
What types of data audits have you performed, and what checks did you use to validate completeness, consistency, and accuracy?
You mention performing data analysis with statistical programs and generating reports. Which programs did you use, what data did you analyze, and how were the reports used by stakeholders?
How have you gathered and explained data requirements for an application or reporting need when working with customers, district staff, or technical teams?
Describe your experience communicating with data architects, programmers, or engineers. What was your role in keeping a data-related project on track?

This role requires building ETL pipelines. Based on your experience managing and validating data, how would you approach designing a process to ingest, clean, validate, and load data into a relational database?
What is your hands-on experience with relational databases, including writing SQL, designing tables, defining relationships, or querying data?
This position relies heavily on Scala, Spark, Java, Spring, AWS, and REST APIs. What exposure, training, or practical work have you had with any of these technologies?
Give an example of managing several complex, deadline-driven data or administrative projects at the same time. How did you prioritize work, communicate status, and maintain quality?
